checks.purpose: Resolve exact subject type, schema and representation; reject unknown fields and changed digests.
Require three present voices with explanatory voices explicitly non-normative.
Resolve each exact source, selector, integrity, standing at capture and permitted target use.
Resolve semantic/drift roles and admitted assignments within the exact scope.
Bind exact generator and require canonical JSON to match deterministic human projection.
Close declared dependency and relation obligations, endpoint pairs and carrier roles.
Verify exact proposed registry, unique index entry, generated lookup and accountable drift route.
Resolve named consumers, compatibility, source/use gaps and all required current affected bindings.
Inspect scoped non-collapse and internal-consistency evidence with exact interpretation and coverage.
Record attributable interpretation/voice/source fidelity review of the exact meaning.
Resolve applicable profile/carrier standing, exact bindings and foundational compatibility.
Freeze exact reviewed inputs, requested effects, owner routes and deterministic output recipes.
Verify the separate exact owner decision selecting this admission effect.
Verify the separate exact admission application and effective lookup visibility.

admission_rule: All checks 01-12 PASS on current exact inputs; check 13 is NOT_EVALUABLE solely because owner admission has not been selected; check 14 is excluded before application. If a Decision already exists, assess its binding and application through the later phases rather than treating it as pending. Required phase/check scopes and exact inputs are in the bound check contract. Eligibility is not a lifecycle state or authority grant. Final admission and application are separate checks.
claim_ceiling: Proposed Definition/v2 evaluation profile and explicit profile-carrier successor. No automatic owner review, semantic truth, profile adoption, Definition admission, current lookup change or runtime implementation.
